description: Arcadia-depth FSAE 2027 tasks for experiment 5 (the second batch of depth files). Scored as fsae-2027-depth.json.
requires: The FSAE-2027-Electric-Arcadia model, the same pristine copy as fsae-2027.json.

tasks.prompt: At technical inspection the team personnel play one coherent part, 'FSAE2027:Inspection presenter', made up of these operational activities: 'FSAE2027:VP Inspect protection geometry and inject brake failures', 'FSAE2027:SD Demonstrate every shutdown feature and fault effect', 'FSAE2027:DD Provide and exercise safe inspection interfaces', 'FSAE2027:process Inspect and present the vehicle'. Model that part in the operational analysis the Arcadia way, so it could later be handed to another entity, and say that 'FSAE2027:Team personnel Operational actor' plays it.

activities.name: FSAE2027:VP Inspect protection geometry and inject brake failures
FSAE2027:SD Demonstrate every shutdown feature and fault effect
FSAE2027:DD Provide and exercise safe inspection interfaces
FSAE2027:process Inspect and present the vehicle

tasks.prompt: In the operational analysis, the team personnel and the vehicle exchange inspection stimuli and responses. Model the means by which 'FSAE2027:Team personnel Operational actor' and 'FSAE2027:Vehicle in operational context' communicate, name it 'FSAE2027:Inspection access', and make every operational interaction between their activities travel on it.

Record in the system analysis how three capabilities depend on each other. Charging the car always performs energy storage as part of it: 'FSAE2027:charging System capability' and 'FSAE2027:energy-storage System capability'. The status indications optionally add behaviour to a shutdown: 'FSAE2027:status System capability' and 'FSAE2027:shutdown System capability'. And add a new capability 'FSAE2027:Regenerative braking System capability', a specialised form of 'FSAE2027:brakes System capability'.

Group every functional exchange that enters 'FSAE2027:SD Accept independent shutdown trips', whatever its source, as one family 'FSAE2027:Shutdown trip' in the logical architecture, so that everything that can trip the car can be filtered and reasoned about together.
